definitions.explanation: A style of cooking where diners grill bite-sized pieces of meat (typically beef) at the table. Often served with various dipping sauces.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{友達|ともだち}と{焼肉|やきにく}を{食|た}べに{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to eat yakiniku with friends on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {焼肉|やきにく}は{自分|じぶん}で{焼|や}きながら{食|た}べます。
examples.english: You grill yakiniku yourself while eating.

examples.japanese: カルビとロースは{焼肉|やきにく}の{定番|ていばん}です。
examples.english: Kalbi and roast are standard yakiniku cuts.

notes:
{焼肉|やきにく} (literally "grilled meat") refers to the dining style where meat is grilled at the table.

Popular cuts:
- カルビ (short ribs)
- ロース (sirloin)
- タン (tongue)
- ハラミ (skirt steak)
- ホルモン (offal/innards)

Serving style:
- Meat is served raw and grilled on a {七輪|しちりん} (charcoal grill) or gas grill
- Dipped in タレ (sweet soy-based sauce) or {塩|しお} (salt)
- Often eaten with {ライス|らいす} (rice) or {冷麺|れいめん} (cold noodles)

Often eaten for celebrations or group gatherings.

{焼肉|やきにく}{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい} (all-you-can-eat yakiniku) is popular.
